features: Karaoke in the player's three-dot menu: vocals are removed so only the instrumental plays, with a full-screen synced lyrics view and lyrics written in English letters
Report a bug in Settings sends your message straight to the developer, no email app needed
Choose your music language when you first open the app; the first Home rows follow it while the app stays in English (change it in AI Hub > AI feed)
Up Next list is now clear liquid glass like the Home navigation bar
Outline lines removed from player buttons, queue and Ambience; Ambience sits centered under the play row
New round liquid-glass Like and Download buttons
New player backgrounds: Snowland (falling snow), Tokyo (neon city lights), Fireworks and Car drift; Blur, Glow animated, Gradient and Live mesh removed
Liquid-glass player background now has flowing wave lines
Player background is the first item in the three-dot menu
Player slider styles (Bar, Wavy, Slim) now work in the new player, each with its own animation
Hiding the thumbnail shows the Pattukal app icon
SponsorBlock auto-skip and Crop thumbnail are on by default
Music Cube is on by default; pick your own six songs from its settings
AI companion switches sources automatically and answers faster; its settings scroll smoothly
Appearance sits right under AI in Settings
Official Pattukal contact email added in About
